'''''TB-73''''' was a [[Pelta-class frigate/Legends|''Pelta''-class frigate]] used during the aftermath of the [[Second Battle of Geonosis/Legends|Second Battle of Geonosis]], when it was tasked with a supply mission to [[Ord Cestus/Legends|Ord Cestus]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. The [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] aboard were infected with [[Geonosian/Legends|Geonosian]] [[Brain worm/Legends|brain worms]] and [[Death/Legends|killed]] the crew. [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Padawan/Legends|Padawans]] [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]] and [[Barriss Offee/Legends|Barriss Offee]], the latter being infected and the former saving the ship, were also on board during [[Skirmish aboard TB-73/Legends|the crisis]]. ''TB-73'' reached its destination, and the brain worms were captured and analyzed.

==Description==
[[File:TB-73_landed.png|thumb|left|200px|Cargo frigate ''TB-73'' on the surface of Geonosis]]
''TB-73'' was a standard [[Pelta-class frigate/Legends|''Pelta''-class frigate]] fitted for supply runs. It had a base color of white with red markings on the top of the bow. It had one primary engine and a Class 2 [[Hyperdrive/Legends|hyperdrive]].<ref name="TCWCG" /> ''TB-73'' also contained shields inside the ship, blocking off certain areas of the ship such as the bridge.<ref name="Brain Invaders" />

==History==
''TB-73'' was used by the [[Republic Navy/Legends|Republic Navy]] around [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]].<ref name="TCW novel">[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars (novelization)|''Star Wars: The Clone Wars'' novelization]]</ref>

It was sent to [[Geonosis/Legends|Geonosis]] following the previous [[Second Battle of Geonosis/Legends|conflict]]. There, [[Padawan/Legends|Padawans]] [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]] and [[Barriss Offee/Legends|Barriss Offee]], along with [[Tango Company/Legends|Tango Company]], were stationed aboard the ship during a medical supply run to a station near the planet [[Ord Cestus/Legends|Ord Cestus]]. Unbeknownst to the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]], company member [[Scythe (clone trooper)/Legends|Scythe]] had been infected with a [[Brain worm/Legends|brain worm]] and was carrying eggs to infect all aboard. ''TB-73'' took off from Geonosis and went into [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]]. While in hyperspace, trooper Scythe planted the eggs and infected some troopers in their quarters while they lay asleep. The brain worms quickly gained control, and soon all troopers were infected. The infected clones began to take over the ship, killing the [[Clone trooper pilot/Legends|pilots]] and attempting to kill the two Jedi, who were eating in the mess hall. The troopers in the bridge set the ship to [[Autopilot/Legends|autopilot]] and raised all the shields, preventing Ahsoka and Barriss from reaching the bridge.<ref name="Brain Invaders" />

[[File:TB-73.png|thumb|left|200px|''TB-73'' departs [[Geonosis/Legends|Geonosis]].]]
The two Jedi moved through the vent system of the ship and decided to split up to reach the reactor room and the communications station. Barriss was caught by an electric trap just short of the reactors and also got infected by the clones. Ahsoka reached the comms station and contacted [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Kit Fisto/Legends|Kit Fisto]], sharing the horrifying news with him. She then turned to find an infected Barriss Offee waiting for her. The two began a duel the young Padawan escaped from through the air ducts.<ref name="Brain Invaders" /> After contacting [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] and finding out that the brain worms die in cold, Ahsoka went to ''TB-73''{{'s}} cooling units and ruptured them, opening up a freezing fog.

[[File:TB-73_bunks.png|thumb|right|220px|The clone trooper bunks aboard ''TB-73'']]

The brain worms began to die within the troopers, and Ahsoka found her way to the bridge just as ''TB-73'' left hyperspace. She began to take control of the ship when Barriss attacked her again. They cut open one of the coolant tubes, which Ahsoka blasted into Barriss's face. The worm began flailing around in Barriss's mouth as she slowly came out of the trance. Meanwhile, two tugboats were attempting to dock ''TB-73'' into the space station and finally succeeded.<ref name="Brain Invaders" /> Kit Fisto and his team quickly boarded the ship and found Barriss and Ahsoka covered in frost on the cockpit floor. The two were taken to the infirmary in the [[Ord Cestus medical station/Legends|Ord Cestus medical station]], where they were met by Master Fisto and Skywalker.<ref name="Brain Invaders" />

==Command and crew==
''TB-73'' had two clone pilots at its helm and was under the command of Jedi Padawans Ahsoka Tano and Barriss Offee. Tango Company was stationed aboard ''TB-73'' during its ill-fated supply mission to the Ord Cestus medical station.<ref name="Brain Invaders" />

==Behind the scenes==
''TB-73'' docks into the medical station horizontally, not vertically like the ships in "[[Shadow of Malevolence|Shadow of ''Malevolence'']]."
